Dynamic Saunas Gracia DYN-6119-01 Elite is a 1-2 person FAR infrared sauna built for indoor use with 7 Ultra Low EMF carbon heating panels and a compact footprint that fits many home wellness spaces. Designed to support comfortable sessions, the Gracia Elite pairs Ultra Low EMF performance (3–5 MG measured 2–3 inches from the heating panels) with an easy, everyday setup using 120V/15amp plug & play power on a non-GFCI connection (a dedicated outlet is recommended). If you want an infrared sauna that’s simple to live with while delivering steady radiant warmth, this model brings the essentials together in a clean, space-conscious cabin.

The Gracia Elite is constructed from Natural Reforested Canadian Hemlock and finished with a clear tempered glass door for a bright interior feel. Inside, the layout is optimized for solo relaxation or sharing the space, while the heating system places FAR infrared carbon panels around the cabin to help create an even, enveloping heat experience. The sauna’s stated ideal range is 118F–132F, and it can heat up to 140F, giving you flexibility to tailor the session to your preference. A roof vent helps support comfort during longer sessions, and the overall design is intended for indoor placement where you want a dedicated wellness corner.

For sessions that feel more immersive and personalized, the Gracia Elite includes an Interior Chromotherapy Color Lighting System plus a Red Light Therapy feature, letting you set a mood that matches your routine—whether you’re winding down after training, resetting after a long day, or building a consistent recovery habit. Day-to-day control is straightforward with the Interior LED Control Panel, and you can add audio to your routine using Bluetooth or the MP3 auxiliary connection through the built-in speaker. Assembly is designed to be approachable with a clasp together build, and the unit ships in 2 boxes to support delivery and handling.

Dynamic Saunas focuses on indoor infrared sauna experiences built around practical installation, consistent heating, and comfort-forward features. As part of a broader collection of well-being products, the brand emphasizes approachable ownership—products that integrate into home routines without complicated infrastructure—while offering defined EMF performance categories like Ultra Low EMF for shoppers who prioritize that specification. If you’re looking for an indoor infrared sauna that balances measured EMF details, everyday controls, and a compact footprint, the Gracia Elite is built to match that kind of use.
